manualInvalidInput: Check the recipient address, amount and asset precision. Your inputs are retained.
manualInsufficient: The available balance cannot cover this amount, fees and existing reserved funds. Review the amount before retrying.
manualDeclined: This confirmation, authentication or operation was canceled. Your inputs are retained.
manualReadFailed: Fresh balances or fees could not be verified. Check the network and retry deliberately.
manualChanged: The account or configuration changed. Return to the accounts and reopen this transfer.
manualNotice: This transfer requires a separate confirmation and system authentication. Skill budgets do not apply.
manualWorking: Checking balances and fees. Review the separate confirmation and complete system authentication.
manualCanceling: Cancellation requested. Waiting for the original operation to stop safely; existing risks are retained.
manualFailed: The operation did not complete. Review the error and original records. Inputs are retained; retry only deliberately.
manualUnavailable: Manual transfer is unavailable in this protected host.
manualSubmitted: Submitted; confirmation and finality are unverified. Check the original records before another payment.
manualUnknown: The transfer outcome is uncertain. Do not resend. Check the original records and transaction.
manualReserved: This network is reserved for the existing Skill wallet. New manual transfers are unavailable here.
manualFeeUnavailable: A complete manual transfer fee cap is not yet available for this network.
title: My wallets
separation: Recovery words and private keys stay in this protected window and are never returned to the LLM.
seedWarning: A complete recovery phrase may control accounts beyond the first account shown here. Choosing a test network does not isolate the key.
firstAccount: Only this account will be imported.
backupWarning: Write all 12 words in order. Anyone with these words controls the wallet. Do not share them in chat.
locked: Protected setup closed. Reopen it from the wallet.
retained: Setup state is retained. No replacement wallet was created.
reenter: Re-enter the original import material to continue this setup.
existing: This account already exists or requires recovery. Its history was retained.
backupIncorrect: The words did not match. Check your backup and try again.
canceled: Setup canceled. Staged recovery material was retained.
ready: Choose how to add an account.
secretCleared: Sensitive content was cleared. Continue the original setup to resume.
chooseImport: Choose how to import the existing wallet.
historyUnregistered: No signing stream is registered here. This does not prove that the account has never made a transfer.
historyEmpty: No retained manual transfer risk is recorded in this registered stream.
historyRiskRetained: These records do not prove finality. Existing signing risks are retained. Skill payment records are separate.
historyFailed: Transfer records could not be verified. Existing risks were retained.
historyCleared: Transfer record details were cleared. Open the account records to view them again.
history_SUBMITTED: Submitted to a node; finality unverified
history_no_record: No broadcast record; no automatic resend
exportNotice: The backup contains the selected keys and all known history at export time. It does not prove current signing continuity.
exportOmitted: These entries will have history but no keys in this backup
exportSeedWarning: A recovery phrase can control more accounts than the first address. A private key restores only its own account. Protect the file and password separately.
exportPasswordRule: Use at least 16 characters, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. This password cannot be recovered by the application.
exportSave: Authenticate and save a new file
exportCoverage: Selected keys: {count}. All known history is included.
exportEmpty: No saved key material is available for backup.
exportUnavailable: Protected backup is unavailable. Existing wallet state was retained.
exportUnknown: The original file publication is uncertain. Check that target; no automatic retry or overwrite will be attempted.
exportChanged: The wallet changed. Reopen backup to review the current coverage; no automatic export was started.
exportCanceled: The backup was canceled or authentication was declined. Reopen backup to start another operation.
exportInvalid: The selected backup material could not be verified. Existing wallet state was retained.
exportBusy: The wallet is busy. No backup was queued.
exportPasswordInvalid: Enter matching passwords with at least 16 characters and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
exportWorking: Complete system authentication and choose a new backup file. Existing files will not be overwritten.
exportComplete: Encrypted backup saved. All keys referenced at this snapshot and all known history are included. Later changes are not included.
exportPartial: Encrypted backup saved with selected keys and all known history. Entries listed as omitted have no keys in this file. Later changes are not included.
exportCanceling: Waiting for the original backup operation to drain. An already completed file publication is not rolled back.
restoreNotice: Select one encrypted general-wallet backup. Existing Skill wallets and budgets are unchanged.
restorePassword: Backup password for this authenticated step
restorePreparing: Choose a backup file and complete system authentication. A password is requested only afterward.
restorePublishing: The original actor will verify this exact plan again before restoring. Complete any new system authentication.
restorePasswordReady: System authentication completed for this step. Enter the backup password.
restorePasswordRejected: The password challenge could not be verified. Cancel or inspect the original operation.
restoreMaterialNotSelected: Material not selected in this backup; local availability requires verification
restoreUnknown: Signing continuity is unknown. This recovery remains read-only for history and receiving; confirmation cannot enable signing or release risks.
restoreContinuity: The plan targets complete local continuity. Actual signing still requires the original native and current-history checks. Local newer facts and risks are retained.
restoreReview: Review this preview before explicitly confirming. This preview has not published the target.
restoreUncertain: The outcome is unknown. Preserve the original plan and inspect it before continuing. Do not automatically retry or assume cancellation rolled it back.
restoreInvalid: The backup or password could not be verified. No automatic restore or overwrite will be attempted.
restoreCanceled: The original restore stopped after drainage. Existing plans and any completed effects remain for inspection.
restoreUnavailable: Protected restore is unavailable. No file or password is admitted here. Existing Skill payments remain separate.
restoreCanceling: Waiting for the original restore task to drain. Existing effects are retained.
restoreCompleteReadOnly: The original restore target reopened in archive-only mode. History and receiving remain available; signing continuity is unknown. Close and reopen wallet management.
restoreComplete: The original restore target reopened. Actual signing remains subject to current native checks. Close and reopen wallet management.
restoreFinished: Restore target reopened. Close this management window.
secretExportWarning: Anyone with these secrets controls this wallet. Keep them private and never send them in chat.
secretExportDerived: The private key controls only this account.
secretExportNoMnemonic: This wallet stores only its private key; no recovery phrase is available.
secretExportVisible: Sensitive content clears when this window loses focus. Revealing again requires authentication.
secretExportDenied: Authentication was not completed. No secret was revealed. Authenticate again to view it.
secretExportFailed: The export could not be verified. No secret is displayed. Reopen the wallet and authenticate again.
paymentConnected: Connected. Select this wallet and configure its payment limits before paying.
paymentUpgradeNotice: This upgrades the existing local payment ledger after creating and verifying a consistent backup. Existing wallets, grants and spending records are preserved. New wallets start with payments disabled and zero limits. The backup remains beside the original ledger; older app versions cannot open the upgraded ledger.
mnemonicCopyFailed: Could not copy recovery words. Try again.
storageAuthorizationRequired: Import could not be saved because Keychain access requires authorization. No system password dialog was opened. Existing wallets were retained.
storageTimeout: Wallet storage timed out. Existing wallets were retained. Re-enter the import material to retry.
importFailed: Import could not be completed. Existing wallets were retained. Check the error below and re-enter the import material to retry.
importPaymentPending: Imported; connect Agent payments from the account list.
accountNeedsRecovery: This account has a pending setup. Continue it from the list below.
